security.title: Privacy and Security
security.accountInfo: Changing your password ends all sessions and requires signing in again. No mandatory periodic password changes apply.
security.avatarInfo: Change or remove your profile photo in My Account. Photos are shown only with authorized account access.
security.quotaInfo: Up to 3 successful normal changes are allowed in a rolling 30 days. Secure account recovery is excluded.
security.sessionsInfo: This counts valid refresh sessions. Device names and individual session sign-out are not available in this version.
security.rightsInfo: You can correct your profile and delete your account. A verified contact channel for other rights requests will be added before publication.
security.deleteInfo: Deletion removes personal and financial records; limited pseudonymous store bindings may remain. Store subscriptions may need separate cancellation.
security.reused: You cannot choose your current password or a previously used password.
security.common: This password is on the common-password list. Choose a different one.
security.limit: Your normal password-change allowance for the last 30 days is exhausted. Account recovery remains available.
security.strengthHelp: This meter is not a guarantee. Some common passwords are blocked; your password is not sent to a third-party breach service.
legal.draft: Legal draft — legal and language review is required before publication. This is not a finalized or fully compliant document.
legal.registration: You can access three draft documents before registration. This information is not consent. No marketing consent is requested; mandatory contract acceptance is not collected during the draft stage.
legal.pending: Data controller identity, request address/channel and verified contact details: To be completed before publication.
legal.noticeBody: Email, name, password hashes, payment/subscription records, preferences, optional photo and device details if notifications are enabled are collected through the app/API for accounts, tracking, security and requested reminders. The legal basis for each purpose must be verified and added before publication. Information is not consent.
legal.privacyBody: Account resources are scoped to the verified user. Passwords are hashed; full encryption or absolute security is not guaranteed. Production security and infrastructure controls must be verified before publication. No marketing or optional analytics consent is collected.
legal.termsBody: PayAhead tracks personal payments and subscriptions; it does not pay bills or automatically verify bank records. Estimates are not guaranteed. Premium depends on verified store status; account deletion does not cancel store subscriptions. Party identity, fees/refunds and dispute terms: To be completed before publication.
legal.retention: Active account data is retained for the account lifetime. Known retired password hashes are removed on account deletion; normal-change timestamps are cleared by maintenance after 30 days. Deletion removes financial records and photos; pseudonymous store bindings may remain. Backups and final retention/deletion schedules require completion before publication.
legal.transfers: Expo may be used when notifications are enabled, Apple/Google for store verification, and the configured SMTP provider for email. Development uses SQL Server, private local photo storage and Mailpit. Production recipients, countries and legal transfer conditions: To be completed before publication.
legal.rights: You may request processing information, access, correction, deletion/destruction where conditions apply, and other legal rights. Profile correction and account deletion are available; a verified request channel will be added before publication. This draft does not replace legal review.
security.historyInfo: History checks cover the current password and those recorded after this feature. Unknown earlier passwords cannot be detected retroactively.
